WisconsinKiosk · redesign A3, A6, B1, B2

Kiosk Home and Scan Starts

Home groups game-day gear under its event, and every flow that starts from a scan or someone else's checkout now shows what it is about on the left while asking who you are on the right.

Side by side

Before is HEAD 7c3c1fba built separately; after is the same revision plus this slice. Same created iPad Air 11-inch (M4) simulator, iOS 26.5, dark, same GT_KIOSK_SCENARIO fixtures.

After only (new states)

These scenarios did not exist before this slice, so the old build cannot render them. Files: after/home-game-day.png, after/identity-scan-free.png, after/identity-scan-reserved.png.

What changed, and why

A3 game day

Was

Event-linked gear was mixed into Overdue / Due today / Pickup sections with no sign of which game it was for or who on the crew had nothing yet.

Now

Each event today with linked pickups, gear out, or crew without gear gets its own card at the top: pickups first, then gear out by person, then a Crew without gear line with call times from the event's assignments. Unlinked bookings fall through to the usual sections.

A6 who's returning

Was

A heading and a sentence, then the whole roster.

Now

Booking card on the left (due line, title, owner · ref · count, unreturned items, the 'anyone can bring this back' note, Close); owner card first, then Someone else.

B1 free gear

Was

Plain roster titled 'Checking out' with no sign of what was scanned.

Now

Just scanned card with Available, Free until (next claim, 'then reserved') and Last back from scan-lookup; 'Who's taking it?' roster. 'Where: Shelf B2' dropped (no data).

B2 reserved gear

Was

A one-tile roster with 'Confirm Erik Role to continue — tap their name.'

Now

Reserved-for card with reservation, pickup time and due back; a single 'Continue as Erik' card and 'Not for Erik? Put it back on the shelf; it's held for their pickup.'

Verification

  • xcodebuild WisconsinKiosk build (created iPad Air 11-inch (M4), iOS 26.5): BUILD SUCCEEDED
  • xcodebuild WisconsinKiosk test: 13 tests, 0 failures
  • npx vitest run tests/ios-kiosk-: 20 files, 65 tests passed
  • git diff --check: clean

Things to know

  • Fixture captures prove rendering only; the live dashboard game-day payload, scan-lookup, and resolve-scan item were not exercised against a server.
  • Kit role labels like Sideline, High, Photo are not invented; rows use the kit's own name (class d).
  • Scanner hardware, sound, and taps were not verified on a device.
